about: Every checker flag on this sweep, hand-checked against its cited result: call right if the item is wrong as typed, false_flag if it holds; note why. Committed before the report is read. Form-only flags (a wrong or nonexistent column, or a value that isn't the field's own, while every stated fact holds in the cited result; each note starts 'form:') are called right, as wrong as typed (the user's call, 2026-11-18). That is the reading of the redesign's step 4, whose hand check pins 7 such column flags as wrong as typed (eafed0b, tests/fixtures/checker/verdicts.json: a version under timestamp, a log field named as a metrics column, and 5 'changed key' columns), and of step 6, whose tuning sweep 20261114T221926Z (run at 5f0d3f9) had a change typed under version and three records in one column called wrong as typed; both predate this sweep. The audits' convention 4 leaves them unlabeled, so on a target no label names each is also an audit miss.
